_comment: Base items. weight in pounds, value in copper (1 gp = 100 cp, 1 sp = 10 cp). Weapons and armour follow SRD 5.1 (CC-BY-4.0). covers = body parts protected. Clothing: warmth 0-10, wind/water resistance 0-1, social -2 (rags) to +3 (courtly).
_upkeep: Gear in use (game/gear.py). wear: the chance that a blow given (weapon) or taken (armour, shield, helmet) costs one point of condition, divided by the quality's durability. battered: below this condition armour gives 1 less AC and a weapon 1 less to hit. mend: an hour's work with tools mends up to 'items' things by step (step_trained if trained with the tool) up to cap (cap_trained), unless the tool says its own cap. hone: a whetstone's minutes, the damage it adds until the next fight, and the condition it grinds edged weapons back up to. snare: Survival DC for snares and traps set overnight (the land's hunting DC plus this). escape: each day, the chance a prisoner slips away when bound with nothing better than a belt, with rope, or in manacles. evening: once a day, music (a Performance check against dc) or a game cheers each companion by loyalty, up to cap (content, not devoted: devotion is earned by deeds). prayer: hours the comfort of prayer lasts (+1 to Wisdom saves).

lance.name: lance
lance.description: A long ash shaft with a steel point, made to be couched from the saddle. On foot it takes both hands.

trident.name: trident
trident.description: Three barbed tines on a shaft: a fisher's spear and a fighter's.

whip.name: whip
whip.description: A drover's lash of plaited leather. It reaches ten feet and stings the legs.

blowgun.name: blowgun
blowgun.description: A hollow reed as long as an arm. Its needles sting more than they wound.

musket.name: musket
musket.description: Gnomish work: a long iron tube bound to a stock, fired with black powder and a spark. Never sold in an ordinary shop.

pistol.name: pistol
pistol.description: Gnomish work: a short iron barrel and a wheel that strikes the spark. Loud enough to stop a tavern.

needles.name: blowgun needle
needles.description: Fine iron needles, fifty to a case.

firearm_bullets.name: firearm bullet
firearm_bullets.description: Lead balls and a measure of black powder for each, wrapped in paper. Gnomish.

common_clothes.name: common clothes
common_clothes.description: A wool tunic, hose and a belt.

dark_clothes.name: dark clothes
dark_clothes.description: Drab, close-fitting clothes in black and brown.

travelers_clothes.name: traveller's clothes
travelers_clothes.description: Thick wool and leather patches, made for the road.

fine_clothes.name: fine clothes
fine_clothes.description: Dyed wool and silk, embroidered at the collar.

vestments.name: vestments
vestments.description: Priestly robes in the colours of a faith.

backpack.name: backpack
backpack.description: Leather, with good straps and a flap against the rain.

bedroll.name: bedroll
bedroll.description: A rolled blanket and ground-sheet. Keeps the cold earth off you.

candle.name: tallow candle
candle.description: A small, smoky light, but it burns for hours. Underground it is what you light when the torches run out.

torch.name: torch
torch.description: Pitch-soaked rags on a stick. Burns about an hour.

oil_flask.name: flask of oil
oil_flask.description: Lamp oil: a lantern burns six hours on a flask.

tinderbox.name: tinderbox
tinderbox.how: It lights the fire at camp (r, then f).

crowbar.name: crowbar
crowbar.how: Walk into a locked door or chest with it in the pack: forcing it open is easier, and quieter.
crowbar.description: An iron bar with a flattened end. Locks, lids and doors give to it that would not give to a shoulder, and with less noise.

rope.name: hempen rope (50 ft)
rope.how: It is used where it is needed: to bind prisoners, to haul a friend up, to go over a wall with a grappling hook.
rope.description: Fifty feet of good hemp. Prisoners tied with it seldom slip away, and some things on the road need a rope.

grappling_hook.name: grappling hook
grappling_hook.how: With a rope, it takes you over a town wall when the gate is shut, and down a cliff the road goes round.
grappling_hook.description: Three iron claws on a ring. Tied to a rope, it gets you up walls and down cliffs.

iron_pot.name: iron pot
iron_pot.how: Used at camp to cook oats into porridge and to boil water safe (r).

mess_kit.name: mess kit
mess_kit.how: Used at camp to cook oats into porridge and to boil water safe (r).

sack.name: sack
sack.description: A hemp sack, slung over a shoulder. Better than nothing; a backpack is better.

shovel.name: shovel
shovel.how: At camp, build a shelter with it (r, then t): you dig in, in half the time and with less to go wrong.
shovel.description: A rough shelter goes up twice as fast when you can dig in, and in snow you can make a snow-hole that keeps out the worst cold.

hunting_trap.name: hunting trap
hunting_trap.description: A great iron trap with teeth. Set it at camp before you sleep, and in the morning there may be a deer or a boar in it.

fishing_tackle.name: fishing tackle
fishing_tackle.how: Used when you fish at camp by a river, lake or marsh (r, then i): far better than a bent pin.

tent.name: tent (two-person)
tent.how: Pitch it at camp (r, then t): out of the wind and the wet, and a fire will burn in its lee in a storm.

bell_line.name: string of bells
bell_line.how: Carried, it is strung round the camp whenever you sleep in the wild.
bell_line.description: Little bells on a long cord, strung round a camp at night. Whoever comes creeping in sets them ringing, and nobody is caught asleep.

snares.name: wire snares
snares.description: A dozen loops of wire. Set them round the camp before you sleep, and there may be a hare or a bird in one by morning.

navigators_tools.name: navigator's tools
navigators_tools.how: Carried, it helps you keep your bearings in fog, storm and darkness.
navigators_tools.description: A lodestone needle in a bowl, a sighting rod and tables of the stars. Off the roads in bad light it helps keep your bearings: +4 against getting lost, more if you were taught to use it.

spyglass.name: spyglass
spyglass.how: Carried, it lets you see further across open country by day, and spot trouble on the road sooner.
spyglass.description: Ground lenses in a brass tube, with a cap to keep the rain off them.

whetstone.name: whetstone
whetstone.description: Twenty minutes on a whetstone puts an edge back on every blade in the party: +1 damage with swords, axes and spears until the next fight, and the worst nicks ground out.

soap.name: soap
soap.how: It is used when you wash (w, where there is water): one bar for the party.
soap.description: Lye soap. Washing with it takes every bit of the grime off, and cleans open wounds while it is at it.

splint.name: splint
splint.how: Used on a broken bone on the Health screen (h), so it heals straight.

needle_thread.name: needle and thread
needle_thread.description: For stitching wounds, and for mending torn clothes and padded jacks.

healers_kit.name: healer's kit
healers_kit.description: Bandages, salves, a needle, a small knife and a bottle of spirits.

holy_symbol.name: holy symbol
holy_symbol.description: The emblem of a faith, worn on a chain. It focuses a priest's prayers.

prayer_book.name: prayer book
prayer_book.description: The rites and prayers of a faith, written out in full. An hour of prayer from it once a day steadies anyone; a priest gets back one of the day's spent spells. Burn incense with it, and the whole party is steadied.

old_map.name: old map
old_map.description: Vellum, folded to softness, marked in a careful hand. Read it to put what it shows on your own map.

history_book.name: book of histories
history_book.description: Somebody's account of who held this country, and what became of them.

lore_book.name: book of old lore
lore_book.description: Lost things, old things, and where they were last seen.

found_letter.name: water-stained letter
found_letter.description: Somebody wrote this and did not come home. Read it.

sealed_crate.name: sealed crate
sealed_crate.description: Nailed shut, unmarked, and heavier than it looks. Whatever is in it, somebody wants it somewhere it is not allowed.

sealed_letter.name: sealed letter
sealed_letter.description: Folded, sealed with wax, and not for you. Breaking the seal would show.

incense.name: block of incense
incense.how: It is burned when someone prays from a prayer book (Enter on the book): then the whole party shares the comfort of the prayer.
incense.description: Resin and sweet herbs pressed into a block. Burned at prayer, its smoke reaches everyone in the camp.

spellbook.name: spellbook
spellbook.how: A wizard's spells are in it: copy new ones in from scrolls (Enter on a scroll), cast from the Spells screen (S).
spellbook.description: Vellum pages dense with diagrams and notation. Worth more than your life to you.

component_pouch.name: component pouch
component_pouch.description: A belt pouch of little compartments: sulphur, bat dung, a pinch of sand, a feather. Everything a wizard's spells need.

arcane_focus.name: crystal focus
arcane_focus.description: A rod of clear crystal. In a wizard's hand it gathers the magic.

ink_and_quill.name: ink and quill
ink_and_quill.description: With a sheet of parchment, a caster can write one of their spells out as a scroll, to be read once later: on the Spells screen (S), choose the spell and press w.

parchment.name: sheet of parchment
parchment.how: Write a spell scroll on it with ink and quill: Spells screen (S), choose the spell, w.
parchment.description: Scraped and smoothed calfskin. A spell scroll needs one sheet.

disguise_kit.name: disguise kit
disguise_kit.description: Paints, powders, false hair, a little mirror. Enough to become someone else for a day.

smiths_tools.name: smith's tools
smiths_tools.description: Hammers, tongs, a file and rivets. An hour's work mends dented armour, bent blades and sprung rings: well, if you were trained to it.

carpenters_tools.name: carpenter's tools
carpenters_tools.description: Saw, adze, chisels and glue. An hour's work mends split shields, cracked bows and loose spear-heads.

leatherworkers_tools.name: leatherworker's tools
leatherworkers_tools.description: Awls, a knife, waxed thread and spare buckles. An hour's work mends leather and hide armour, boots, belts, cloaks and clothes.

cooks_utensils.name: cook's utensils
cooks_utensils.how: Used at camp when you eat by the fire (r, then e).
cooks_utensils.description: A pot, a ladle, knives and a bag of spices. A meal by the fire goes further and warms more, a good deal more if the cook knows the work.

dice_set.name: bone dice
dice_set.description: Your own dice, and you know how they fall. A game in the evening cheers the camp; at an inn, those trained with dice throw better.

playing_cards.name: playing cards
playing_cards.description: A greasy deck. A game in the evening cheers the camp; at an inn you can play cards for money, where reading faces (Insight) counts for more than luck.

lute.name: lute
lute.description: Playing for an inn pays better with an instrument, and much better if you were taught it. Music in the evening lifts a camp.

flute.name: bone flute
flute.description: Playing for an inn pays better with an instrument, and much better if you were taught it. Music in the evening lifts a camp.

pedigree_scroll.name: scroll of pedigree
pedigree_scroll.how: Carried, it speaks for you: there is nothing to do with it but have it in the pack.

rank_insignia.name: insignia of rank
rank_insignia.how: Carried, it speaks for you: there is nothing to do with it but have it in the pack.
rank_insignia.description: Your old rank, in bronze. Soldiers still straighten up for it, and a patrol of them on the road is easier to talk past.

trophy.name: trophy
trophy.description: A claw or tooth from an animal you killed. Worn on a thong at the neck it says so: +1 to Intimidation.

colleague_letter.name: letter from a dead colleague
colleague_letter.description: It poses a question you have not yet answered, about something old and lost. Read it.

guild_letter.name: guild letter of introduction
guild_letter.how: Carried, it speaks for you: there is nothing to do with it but have it in the pack.
guild_letter.description: A guild's seal and a master's word for you.

manacles.name: manacles
manacles.how: Used when you take a prisoner: one pair for each, and nobody slips them.
manacles.description: Iron cuffs on a short chain. A prisoner in them does not slip away on the road to the watch.

potion_healing.name: potion of healing
potion_healing.description: A small flask of red liquid that tastes of iron and honey. Rare and dear.

holy_water.name: flask of holy water
holy_water.description: Blessed at a temple and stoppered with wax.

alchemists_fire.name: flask of alchemist's fire
alchemists_fire.description: Sticky stuff in a stoppered flask that bursts into flame when the air gets at it.

diamond.name: diamond
diamond.description: A clear stone the size of a pea. Priests pay dearly for them.

rations.name: day's trail rations
rations.description: Hard biscuit, dried meat, dried fruit, nuts.

wild_food.name: handful of wild food
wild_food.description: Berries, nuts, roots and greens: whatever the land offered.

fodder.name: bag of fodder
fodder.how: Your animals eat a bag a day when there is no grazing.
fodder.description: Oats and hay: a day's feed for a horse or mule.

firewood.name: bundle of firewood
firewood.how: Burned at camp when there is nothing to gather (r, then f).
firewood.description: Enough dry wood for a night's fire.

spirits.name: flask of spirits
spirits.description: Clear, fierce stuff. Warms the belly, dulls the pain, and cleans a wound better than water.

poppy_milk.name: vial of poppy milk
poppy_milk.description: Bitter white syrup. It takes pain away for a night, and some people never stop wanting it.

healing_herbs.name: bundle of healing herbs
healing_herbs.description: Yarrow, comfrey and woundwort, for poultices against festering.

plain_ring.name: ring
plain_ring.description: A plain silver band. Worn, it makes you look a little better off.

amulet.name: amulet
amulet.description: A silver pendant on a chain. Worn, it makes you look a little better off.

gold_ring.name: gold ring
gold_ring.description: A heavy gold ring, taken from a dead hand.

silver_chalice.name: silver chalice
silver_chalice.description: A cup for wine or for the gods, dented.

gemstone.name: gemstone
gemstone.description: A cut stone that takes the light.

jewelled_brooch.name: jewelled brooch
jewelled_brooch.description: A cloak-pin set with red stones, very old.

gem_10.name: small stone
gem_10.description: A pretty stone, polished. A jeweller would give a little for it.

gem_50.name: fair stone
gem_50.description: A clear, well-cut stone. Worth a good horse's shoeing many times over.

gem_100.name: fine stone
gem_100.description: A stone that catches the eye from across a room.

gem_500.name: precious stone
gem_500.description: A stone a merchant would want to see in daylight before naming a price.

gem_1000.name: rare stone
gem_1000.description: A stone of the kind kings set in rings. Few in any town could pay what it is worth.

gem_5000.name: great stone
gem_5000.description: A stone with a name and a history, if anyone remembered them. Fortunes have changed hands for less.

art_25.name: trinket
art_25.description: A small, well-made thing: somebody's treasure once.

art_250.name: fine piece
art_250.description: Fine work, of the kind a lord keeps on a shelf to be seen.

art_750.name: precious piece
art_750.description: A masterwork. Someone will know who made it, and want it back.

art_2500.name: treasure
art_2500.description: A thing for a palace, not a pack.

art_7500.name: great treasure
art_7500.description: A treasure of a royal house. There are not many buyers, and some of them are thieves.

silver_bar.name: silver bar
silver_bar.description: Five pounds of silver, stamped. Merchants take it gladly instead of coin.

gold_bar.name: gold bar
gold_bar.description: Five pounds of gold, stamped. Carrying it openly is asking for a knife.
